producerBuildFailure.reason: Isolated source snapshot lacks util/release_ver. gen_ver.pl does not consume the Makefile SRC_VERSION override. Native4 compiled the corrected Oozle UI and species tests successfully, then failed its build.h prerequisite before linking.
producerBuildFailure.repair: The producing owner needs a fresh bound build phase with util/release_ver in its owned snapshot, using the bound canonical version. Preserve native4 artifacts.
producerBuildFailure.successorPolicy: A later successful compatible build may replace native4 after verifying the Oozle inputs and binding its binary and matching assets.
